facts.fact: The faltering pair at the bend is a slight guard from Usha's riders (shape low, quick, dark, unnamed) paired with Vasu at dusk; ch24 did not show this pairing.
A boar fights beside Bhaskaran, an otter beside Thilak, and Sanu's long shape beside Kandan on the wall.
Haran's three hundred crown spears hold the centre but are engaged around the tower's ram, too far down the line to close the bend, so only Devan and Neela, then Vellan's bear, fill the gap.
Before stepping into the gap Devan says 'Left' aloud, honouring the tack-room term 'say it before you do it', and Neela answers with a shoulder pressed to his hip.
